recommendation: V117 is a useful single-view photo-score option with a modest weak-material/carrier improvement over V114. V114 retains higher measured-camera means and lower ADC color bias; V115 retains its higher known-camera mean. Keep the normalized-band term off for further quality work: V118 has lower weak natural-detail response than its matched control and a large ADC magenta-tail regression. These are measured tradeoffs, not a study gate freezing an architectural baseline. Real foliage/neon detail and broad RawNIND superiority remain unresolved.
scope: Both original fresh-from-V114 seed64 native256/B16/BF16 20k runs, common90864-source data/corrected masks, all8 declared stages and independently rebuilt metrics. V118-versus-V117 changes only band weight. Parent comparisons also add training and common mask/seed changes. Source/scene intervals do not measure training-seed uncertainty; real references are approximate. Original receipts/sources remain unchanged. Complete100MP/16bit output works; fine-detail recovery, broad real-photo superiority, SOTA and100MP/10s remain open.
